description: The mutation rows of the package: one deliberate break of one safeguard each, the test files that catch it, and where the row came from. scripts/mutation-check.mjs applies a row to a scratch copy and runs the tests; see the README. status is caught (a test fails under the row) or retired (the code the row broke no longer exists; the reason says what holds the claim now).
